modules.name: Galaxy XR Fan Control
modules.description: Override the system fan speed (default: max speed), with a built-in configuration WebUI for custom steps or a temperature-based curve.

modules.name: Galaxy XR No Low-Light Toast
modules.description: Disable the ambient light sensor pipeline so the "Brighten your area for better performance." low-light popup never appears.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Passthrough Anywhere
modules.description: Toggle passthrough inside any XR app with the headset's physical double-tap, without minimizing it. Double-tap again to return to the app.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Camera Debug WebStream
modules.description: Stream all 13 physical headset cameras as MJPEG over HTTP on port 8080 at native sensor rates, starting at boot.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Mic Gain Boost
modules.description: +15 dB mic gain only while Virtual Desktop records (VOICE_PERFORMANCE source). Event-driven, no polling. Screen recording / other apps alone are untouched. MODE in config.conf.
